maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from leasing modular offices and storage containers on rental, not repair or servicing of customer-owned installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private construction, commercial, retail and industrial businesses renting offices and storage; schools and government are minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew via the Mobile Mini merger and past deals, but now mainly grows through leasing fleet, pricing and organic expansion.

mission_critical.reason: Rented modular offices and storage containers are fairly standard; customers can switch to competitors like Sunbelt or Pac-Van at lease end.

notes: Acquisition history is significant, but current growth is mostly organic, so the call is somewhat uncertain.
